question.problem:
Find the formula for the $n$th term of an arithmetic sequence if the first term is $5$ and the second term is $12.$

$f(n)=$
{{field-1}}
$,\,n\ge 1$
question.worked_solution:
The formula for the $n$th term of an arithmetic sequence (in function notation) is

$$
f(n)=f(1)+(n-1)d.
$$

We are given the first term $f(1)=5.$ Also, the common difference of the sequence can be found as

$$
d=12-5=7.
$$

So, we substitute into the formula and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(n) & =f(1)+(n-1)d \\  & =5+(n-1)(7) \\  & =5+7n-7 \\  & =7n-2\end{aligned}
$$
